item.title: Version 1.1.14
item.description:
What's New in StockDeck 1.1.14

  • Watchlist & Portfolio Drag-and-Drop: Reorder Watchlists, Portfolios, and Watchlist symbols across the Desktop Sidebar and Menu Bar Popover with a zero-lag stationary drop indicator and commit-on-drop architecture.
  • Native AI Sign-In & Dynamic Models: Added OAuth PKCE sign-in for Gemini and OpenAI alongside dynamic model list loading.
  • Earnings Calendar & Guidance: Added upcoming earnings calendar, management guidance outlook, and net income tracking.
  • 5-Year Insider Trading Archive: Added incremental 5-year insider transaction history, daily transaction grouping, and 10b5-1 plan filtering.
